violations.text: Ham and cheese were observed held between 55-49 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Ham and cheese were voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Establishment is to monitor temperatures in prep unit and ensure that unit is able to keep an internal food temperature of 41 DF or less. All other food in prep unit was observed in temperature at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Chicken and cheese were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Time logs were not being maintained for pizza. Time as a public health control is contingent on maintaining proper logs. Time logs were printed for PIC at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Establishment is to label all spray bottles. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. -Mixer -2 door reach-in shelves -Storage shelves -Chest freezer -Fryolator -Cook line Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026
Establishment has no running water at the mop sink. Mop sinks must have running water. New Violation. Correct By: 07/03/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026
The floor and wall junctures under the 3-bay sink do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (deli slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. The deli Slicer was properly cleaned and sanitized by the PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2025

Several food items prepared on site and frozen for storage were observed not re-datemarked with 6 days from the date of thawing. PIC is to ensure frozen prepped items are re-datemarked and not held no longer than 7 days from the date of prep (Prep date is day 1, thawing date is day 2). New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2025

Spray bottles containing Chemicals/Cleaners were stored hanging from the clean equipment shelf over a prep table in the back kitchen area. Spray bottles were relocated for proper storage at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2025

The screen door to the outside, located in the kitchen, is not tight-fitting (gap at the base). Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2025

The smooth surface wall located behind the mop sink is worn and exposing the raw material of the wall board. The wall board is to be resealed to ensure it is smooth, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2025
